svg.title: Walls, doors, accesses and stairs — img16
svg.desc: Reviewed architectural vector tracing of OriginalFloorplan/img16.jpg. Original pixel coordinates and aspect ratio retained. Walls, structural columns, doors, access thresholds and three staircases only. Door swings and adjoining wall openings were compared with enlarged source regions; unequal paired leaves and separate vestibule doors are retained. No embedded raster images, visible labels, furniture, sanitary fixtures, window-opening symbols, area colors or site markings. Segments hidden by labels, particularly simulation-room entries and the lower classroom divider, remain inferred. Approximate tracing from a labeled raster, not a dimensioned architectural survey.
